prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1239; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss on the left-turn collision. Insured reports the other vehicle came through the oncoming lane while insured was turning left at the intersection. Insured states no injuries at scene. Photos requested from insured.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from insured. Insured confirms signal phase was green for the opposing traffic and that the claimant's vehicle struck the driver side of insured's vehicle. Police report number logged and requested. Liability appears disputed pending witness contact.

Entry 3: Claimant's counsel has provided notice of representation. All further contact to go through counsel. Claimant reports lower back strain and is following up with a treating provider. Medical authorization requested through counsel and a records request is in process.

Entry 4: Independent appraiser assigned to inspect both vehicles. Damage to insured vehicle consistent with a side impact. Repair estimate received and under review. Rental coverage confirmed for insured for the duration of repairs.

Entry 5: Counsel has submitted a demand package including treatment notes and wage documentation for the back strain. File referred to supervisor for evaluation. Liability position remains under review, and a reserve review is scheduled for the next file audit.
